title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 25: The Door Opens

planning.voiceReason: People make room for different needs in a shared celebration.
planning.desire: Final inspection clears the centre for its agreed use. An enthusiastic young adult volunteer overwhelms the opening programme with their favourite music, while a neighbour worries that quieter visitors will be left out. Jon helps them make room for one another. The shared meal, garden route, learner writing and photographs become parts of one community event.
planning.payoff: The centre opens with a named maintenance rota, consent-based responsibilities and continuity intact. Jon's role shifts from indispensable rescuer to one accountable member of the community.
planning.convergence: Every target gets two distinct meaningful uses on the common path; optional choice text is not the sole exposure. Choices change tone, approach and acknowledgment, not permanent plot branches.
planning.obstacle: Others need room to choose, while Jon is tempted to organize their feelings for them.
planning.dramaticChange: Jon gives up control and listens to a concrete request.
sceneActivities: Jon sways to music, stops at Daro’s request and steps aside; the group tests the volume, reviews duties and shares a meal.
planning.listenerTurn: Pair → Daro asks for room → listener Jon → stops swaying and steps aside → pair.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Warm practical questions; open hands become attentive stillness when corrected.
actingSignature.Luma: Dry humour with her husband, direct about consent; worry gives way to self-chosen participation.
actingSignature.Daro: Affectionate and blunt; shifts from easy reassurance to concrete requests.
actingSignature.Nia: Enthusiastic young adult; defensive retreat becomes a practical offer.
actingSignature.Ryn: Precise technical limits and agreed working terms.
actingSignature.Sela: Plain patient questions, respects voluntary participation.

continuation.end: Final safety inspection clears the repaired centre for its agreed use. Nia and Daro agree low-volume music and quiet conversation times after a sound check. The promised seedlings and their separate watering supply arrive. Qualified nest management is complete; the old garden path remains closed and the checked alternate route is used. Tavi supplies the shared meal and its cooking water. Sela presents learner writing and consented photographs. Named, consenting duties are recorded: Ryn paid pipe inspections under agreed trial terms, Vek records issues and arranges qualified roof/other work and replacements, Sela reading activities, Edda safe garden route, Jonathan scheduled shifts. Absence is reported; substitutes must consent and be qualified; safety failures close the centre. An limitations, all deaths, losses, promises, allocations and station water remain binding. Jon accepts membership rather than indispensability. The current story arc is complete.
